entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Semenn pase a yo kraze plat atè mwatye nètrènè nan Japanntonn pou tèt yo tap chache 7Jann." t="Last week dey flatline half the netrunners in Japantown because dey were looking for 7Jane." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Semenn pase a yo kraze plat atè mwatye nètrènè nan Japanntonn pou tèt yo tap chache 7Jann." t="Săptămâna trecută au lichidat jumătate din netrunnerii din Japantown pentru că o căutau pe 7Jane." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Brijit pat janm gen yon chans." t="Brigitte never stood a chance." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Brijit pat janm gen yon chans." t="Brigitte n-a avut nicio șansă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kidonk manzè ekziste tout bon vre." t="So she does exist." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kidonk manzè ekziste tout bon vre." t="Deci chiar e reală." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Epi pou tèt yo se Nètwash, yo antere tousa net." t="And of course, being NetWatch, dey bury de whole thing." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Epi pou tèt yo se Nètwash, yo antere tousa net." t="Și, normal, fiind NetWatch, au îngropat totul." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Epi? Yo pran 7Jann?" t="And? Dey get 7Jane?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Epi? Yo pran 7Jann?" t="Și? Au prins-o pe 7Jane?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wè. Men se pa t pa n li te ye." t="See, but it wasn't for us." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wè. Men se pa t pa n li te ye." t="Vezi, dar nu era pentru noi." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nètwash sèvi ak ranyon yo pou enfiltre moun." t="NetWatch make de ranyon dey Trojan Horse." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nètwash sèvi ak ranyon yo pou enfiltre moun." t="NetWatch a făcut din ranyon un cal troian." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen parye avè w manzè tap travay pou yo an lontan." t="I bet she was working for dem from de very beginning." b="" a=""/>
entries.en_m: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen parye avè w manzè tap travay pou yo an lontan." t="I bet he was working for dem from de very beginning." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen parye avè w manzè tap travay pou yo an lontan." t="Pun pariu că lucra pentru ei de la început." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men kijan Brijit sipoze konnen sa?" t="But how was Brigitte supposed to know?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men kijan Brijit sipoze konnen sa?" t="Dar cum era să știe Brigitte?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se pa yon loa manzè ye. Li ka fè erè menm jan ak tout moun." t="It's not like she was a loa. She make mistakes just like everyone." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se pa yon loa manzè ye. Li ka fè erè menm jan ak tout moun." t="Nu era vreo loa. Greșește ca oricine." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men erè sa pwan vi de anpil bon moun nou." t="But dat one cost the lives of our best people." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men erè sa pwan vi de anpil bon moun nou." t="Dar greșeala aia a costat viețile celor mai buni oameni ai noștri." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Aha. Sèlman kounye a yo ap rele l'Erzulie D'en Tort." t="Aha. Only now dey're calling her Erzulie D'en Tort." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Aha. Sèlman kounye a yo ap rele l'Erzulie D'en Tort." t="Aha. Acum o numesc Erzulie D'en Tort." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wi, Se li menm kap tire vanjans pou nou." t="Yes, the one who will avenge us." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wi, Se li menm kap tire vanjans pou nou." t="Da, cea care o să ne răzbune." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nètwash pral pèdi match la." t="It'll be game over for NetWatch." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nètwash pral pèdi match la." t="Gata, NetWatch e terminat." b="" a=""/>
